Risk Description: Administrator account compromise due to missing MFA
Control Gap: MFA is not enforced for all administrators
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all administrator accounts

Risk Description: Delayed response during a security incident

Recommended Remediation: Implement subcontractor risk assessments and annual reviews

Risk Description: Security events are unavailable for investigation
Control Gap: Log retention is shorter than recommended
Recommended Remediation: Increase log retention to at least 12 months

Risk Description: Security awareness gaps increase phishing risk
Control Gap: Training completion is not consistently tracked
Recommended Remediation: Implement centralized training tracking and recurring phishing simulations

Risk Description: Business disruption due to untested recovery procedures
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual BCP and disaster recovery exercises

Control Gap: Review evidence may not always be retained
Recommended Remediation: Document access review approvals and remediation actions
